_comment: Image LoRAs for local generation, one entry per file. Copied to $DATA_DIR/image_loras.json on first use; edit that copy. Entries added here later show up in an existing copy too; only a version bump replaces it wholesale (the old one is kept as image_loras.json.bak). family: which model the file is for -- a file from the wrong family makes a worse image rather than an error, so download into models/loras/<family>/ (e.g. models/loras/qwen21/) and the folder classifies it whatever it is named. kind: realism, detail, style, adult, other. Up to 3 adult LoRAs per image. strength is the default; range is what works. steps / scheduler / sampler / cfg override the engine's defaults when this LoRA is used -- Krea 2 Turbo's are 8 / simple / euler / 1.0, Qwen Image 2.1's are 30 / simple / euler / 2.0, Chroma1-HD's are 26 / beta(0.45,0.45) / euler / 3.8 (Chroma takes its sigmas from BetaSamplingScheduler, so a scheduler named here does nothing to it). trigger is added to the prompt automatically. Notes starting GO-TO or AVOID steer the agent.

loras.label: Realism v1
loras.notes: Older photorealism LoRA; prefer Realism v2 when installed.

loras.label: Realism v2
loras.notes: Newer photorealism LoRA: skin, light, lens character. Good default for photo portraits; use instead of v1.

loras.label: Realistic snapshot
loras.notes: Candid phone-snapshot look: natural flash, casual framing, less polish.

loras.label: Enhancer
loras.notes: AVOID: gives poor results on this setup. Don't use it unless the user asks by name; use the photo-detail slider for crispness.

loras.label: Photo-detail slider
loras.notes: Pulls images back to photographic detail; raise towards 2 if results drift anime or plastic.

loras.label: Mystic XXX v3
loras.notes: GO-TO adult LoRA, together with SNOFS: the best adult results so far. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: SNOFS
loras.notes: GO-TO adult LoRA, together with Mystic XXX: the best adult results so far. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: NSFW Master Turbo
loras.notes: Adult content tuned for Turbo. Add as a third adult LoRA only when SNOFS + Mystic XXX aren't enough. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: Krea 2 NSFW v4
loras.notes: Adult content LoRA (Civitai 2725430). Alternative third adult LoRA when SNOFS + Mystic XXX aren't enough. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: Dark brush
loras.notes: Official Krea 2 style LoRA: muted minimalist ink sketch.

loras.label: Sunset blur
loras.notes: Official Krea 2 style LoRA: dreamy motion blur, sunset tones.

loras.label: Mystic XXX (Z-Image)
loras.notes: GO-TO adult LoRA for Z-Image Turbo, the ZIT build of Mystic XXX. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: PhotoReal BetterNudes (Z-Image)
loras.notes: Alternative to Mystic XXX for Z-Image; use one or the other.

loras.label: HMNSFW AIO (Krea 2)
loras.notes: All-in-one adult LoRA. Counts as adult, so naming it replaces the automatic pair instead of stacking on top of it. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: Qwen Image 2.1 Fix (Envy)
loras.notes: ALWAYS ON: attached to every Qwen Image 2.1 image, adult or not. Repairs layers the base model ships broken, which is what its advertised quality depends on. Nothing to ask for.

loras.label: NSFW (Qwen 2.1, TheseAlpacas)
loras.notes: GO-TO adult LoRA for Qwen Image 2.1. Only behaves at cfg 1 on er_sde/beta, which it sets itself. Fictional adults only.

loras.label: Age slider (Qwen 2.1)
loras.notes: Slider, not a content LoRA: higher pushes the face older. Ask for it when a subject is reading younger than the prompt says. Not attached on its own.

loras.label: Detail Enhancer (Elusarca)
loras.notes: GO-TO for sharpening an existing image on an edit. Its trigger is the whole instruction: edit with the prompt 'enhance this image' and little else.

loras.label: Lenovo UltraReal (Qwen 2.1)
loras.notes: Photoreal skin and light. Keep it light -- above about 0.7 it takes over the whole look.

loras.label: Anime to Realism (Qwen 2.1)
loras.notes: Edit-only: turns an anime or cartoon reference into a photograph. Pointless on a photo.

loras.label: Portrait2CharRef (Qwen 2.1)
loras.notes: Edit-only: turns one portrait into a multi-angle character sheet on white. Wants a 3:2 size.
